state.requirement: User requests complete localruntime source-owned Queue plus File workflows, no manual installs. Released compiler accepts Queue<File> and Queue<Contract{attachment:file}>, so unsupported exposed source cannot be claimed complete. Preserve original authenticated File observations, typed historical census, State mutation atomicity, dispatch/queue retries, restart recovery, current receiver authority, and original SEND evaluation order. Proposed runtime additions are not qualified output yet.
state.verified: Original native State SEND is genuine scope with caller identity and canonical File binding. Work stageCanonicalSend creates retained outbox intent and work.dispatch row atomically with original business State effects. Work dispatch currently retains only sourceGuard and filePayloadOrigin when guarded; unguarded queue sends retain no typed File origin. Intake occurs actor-null later and cannot fabricate/reconstruct a genuine File observation from ref/DTO. Existing opaque.prepare can enroll real original caller File observations at original SEND and later revalidate borrowed retained facts; existing event-input header recipes currently own schedule/handler slots. New queue intake source-routing queued-routes recipe and handler typed origins use original compiler events inputs/inputFields and bounded original outbox/dispatch+census checks. Same source closure includes genuine File policy/Identity/R2 adapter. Current actual FileRef store requires original header on every opaque payload including File-free payloads.
state.a: Extend existing work.dispatch with optional exact queuePayload+queuePayloadOrigin pair, preserving pair through all Work state transitions/retries. Add minimal event-input target queue-publication carrying actual original Work intent identity; defining State validates original event declaration and target, Work resolver compares actual physical dispatch/outbox publication fields and exact queue payload. Original SEND producer callback prepares payload/header using actual State call, original compiler Queue declaration, opts.identity and real files.observe, then commits together with business/outbox. Later actor-null queue intake borrows this physical typed source with original receiver facts and full revalidation. Existing sourceGuard/header remains independent; both may coexist. Extend private retained source resolver/header selection only for this exact slot. No public flag, fake guard or generic SDK.
state.b: Create a separate owning work.queue_publication model row with original intent identity, scoped typed payload+header and same event-input queue-publication target. Original SEND stages this genuine row/header alongside existing dispatch/outbox/business commit. Intake reads exact derived publication row and original dispatch/outbox, revalidates File source, then stages retained handlers/source receipt. Requires new Work model/profile/commands/census inclusion and lifetime retention decisions, but leaves existing dispatch fields and transitions simpler. Same native callback and current Files authority needed. No extra cloud service or public syntax.
state.constraints: Both must have same source behavior, permission/replay/failure bounds and real tests. Compare total maintenance, atomicity, existing producer ownership and failure recovery fairly. Reusing a row alone is not sufficient; preserving new pair through every transition must be demonstrated. Separate row must not orphan/lose lifetime with original Work dispatch. Neither may use TestOnly stores or fabricate actor-null receiving authority. Do not select a fake always-true sourceGuard alternative.

direction.instructions: Choose the smallest complete and maintainable implementation for the verified original-source provenance requirement.

criteria.dispatch_payload_pair: Retain queue payload plus its genuine typed origin on actual dispatch, preserving it through existing transitions.
criteria.publication_row: Retain the original queue File payload in a new Work publication model atomically joined with dispatch.
criteria.investigate: Resolve a specific missing semantic requirement before accepting A or B.
